1–4 位字母（或字母与数字）；个人电台常见 2–3 位字母，1 位、4 位及带: One to four letters (or letters and digits); personal stations usually have two or three letters, while one- and four-character suffixes and those with digits are reserved by the national authority
「在线查询」再补全姓名、QTH 与网格，数据来自 Callook（美加）与 Ha: “Online lookup” then fills in name, QTH and grid from Callook (US/Canada) and HamQTH (international); unavailable on pure static hosting.
一般业余无线电台，省级机构按 G、H、I、D、A、B、C、E、F、K、L 的顺序: General amateur stations; provincial authorities issue the second letter in the order G, H, I, D, A, B, C, E, F, K, L. BG is the most common
业余中继台与业余信标台使用: Used by amateur repeaters and amateur beacons
中国呼号第三位数字 0–9，对应省区；其他国家的数字多表示国内划分区: Third character of a Chinese callsign (0–9), mapping to provinces; in other countries the digit usually marks a domestic call area
中国呼号第二位字母：一般业余台按 G、H、I、D、A、B、C、E、F、K、L 的: Second letter of a Chinese callsign: general amateur stations are issued in the order G, H, I, D, A, B, C, E, F, K, L; J is for space stations; R is for repeaters and beacons
中国大陆呼号形如「B + 台站类别字母 + 分区数字 + 后缀」，常见 5–6: A mainland Chinese callsign looks like “B + station class letter + call-area digit + suffix”, usually 5–6 characters, e.g. BG4XYZ.
便携操作（Portable，在临时地点设台）: Portable operation (set up at a temporary location)
可选，表示操作方式（/P、/M、/QRP）或异地设台（/6）: Optional; marks the operating style (/P, /M, /QRP) or operating from another call area (/6)
台湾地区用 BM–BQ、BU–BX，香港用 VR，澳门用 XX9，都不按中国大陆: Taiwan uses BM–BQ and BU–BX, Hong Kong uses VR and Macao uses XX9; none of them follow the mainland rule for the second letter.
台站类别、分区号与斜杠后缀都能在本页表格里查到；全球前缀速查见「呼号前缀」页。: Station classes, call areas and slash suffixes are all in the tables above; for a global prefix lookup see the Callsign prefixes page.
呼号里的数字在中国表示分区；日本 JA1–JA0、美国 W1–W0 等表示各自的: In China the digit is the call area; Japan (JA1–JA0) and the US (W1–W0) use digits for their own domestic areas with different meanings.
国家无线电管理机构保留；BY、BZ 旧时曾指配给集体台，现行规定没有这一用途: Reserved by the national radio management authority; BY and BZ were once assigned to club stations, but current rules give them no such use
国际电联《无线电规则》第 19.68 款：业余呼号由前缀、一位数字和不超过 4: ITU Radio Regulations No. 19.68: an amateur callsign has a prefix, one digit and a suffix group of at most four characters whose last character must be a letter; the prefix is two characters, or one character limited to the letters B, F, G, I, K, M, N, R or W. Amateur stations may use the digits 0 and 1, and on special occasions the administration may authorise a longer suffix (No. 19.68A).
国际电联分配的国家 / 地区代号：中国大陆为 B，台湾地区为 BM–BQ、BU–: Country/region code assigned by the ITU: B for mainland China, BM–BQ and BU–BX for Taiwan, VR for Hong Kong, XX9 for Macao
在其他分区操作（数字表示分区号）: Operating in another zone (the digit is the zone number)
在地址后加上 `?call=BA1XX` 可分享查询结果，打开页面即自动发起一次: Append `?call=BA1XX` to the URL to share the result; opening that link runs an online lookup automatically.
擅自编制、使用业余无线电台呼号属于禁止行为，要依法承担责任（《业余无线电台管理办: Making up or using an amateur callsign without authorisation is prohibited and carries legal liability (Article 43 of the Administrative Measures for Amateur Radio Stations).
斜杠后缀只描述本次操作方式，不改变呼号归属；日志里应同时记录主呼号与后缀。: A slash suffix only describes this operation and does not change the callsign's home; log both the base callsign and the suffix.
本地解析完全离线：不联网也能查国家 / 地区、DXCC 实体、CQ / ITU: Local parsing works fully offline: country/region, DXCC entity, CQ/ITU zones and rarity are available without a network.
移动操作（Mobile，车载等移动中）: Mobile operation (in a vehicle and the like)
空间业余无线电台使用，分区号固定为 1: Used by amateur space stations; the call-area digit is always 1
解析后可对照「DXCC 稀有度榜单」判断追台价值，或到「通联日志」录入该呼号。: Compare the result with the DXCC Most Wanted list to judge chase value, or add the callsign to the logbook.
